snippet.title: PlayStation - Deep Sea Adventure - Kaitei Kyuu Panthalassa no Nazo (1997)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Deep Sea Adventure: Kaitei Kyuu Panthalassa no Nazo is an Adventure game, developed by Barnhouse Effect and published by Takara, which was released in Japan in 1997.
